text: Coffee with Rohan. His band finally has a gig, May 14 at the Crown, and he's bricking it because it's their first with the new drummer. They're mostly doing their own stuff plus a Talking Heads cover. His girlfriend Lola is making the merch, tote bags with a screen-printed fox. Must text him good luck that afternoon.

Kasia's into bouldering now, three nights a week at the wall on Mill Lane. Her sister Dorota got her into it. They're both entering a comp sometime in the spring. Dorota's new job at the council starts early March so she's cramming in sessions before then. Kasia's flat move got pushed back again too, now end of the month.

Long catch-up with Juan and Chiara over dinner. Juan's half marathon is June 3rd, his first one, and his knee's been playing up so he's anxious about it. Chiara has started knitting, mostly socks, and wants a proper yarn swift, which would make a decent birthday present. Her birthday is end of the month I think. Should ask Juan which colour she'd like.
Jin's daughter has a piano recital sometime next week. Jin is more nervous than she is apparently.

Called Oisín. Cork are in the hurling final 9/12 and he's got tickets for him and his dad. He's been a Cork fan since he could walk. His dad's just finished chemo so this is a big day out for them both. Oisín's partner Kasia is staying home with the baby. Ring him the week after to hear about it.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before early March.
Lola and Yosef are doing the Edinburgh Fringe over the summer, a two-hander they wrote together. Lola's mum is flying over to see it. Remind me to ask Yosef for the dates once they're confirmed.
Nasser said the five-a-side tournament on Saturday got called off, pitch flooded. He's gutted, they'd been training for weeks.
Deepa is reading her way through every Le Guin novel. Currently on The Dispossessed. Loves anything with a map at the front.
Ran into Malik at the shops. His dog Biscuit had her op on Tuesday and is recovering slowly. He looked shattered. I should drop round with something at the weekend.
Kavya's chess club has the county league match on April 2nd. She's top board this year, which is a big deal. Her brother Anil is driving her there.

Aaliyah got into the community choir! Rehearsals start after Christmas. She was so worried about the audition. First concert is sometime in the spring, Fauré Requiem. Her husband Leon is threatening to come and film the whole thing. Must send her a proper congrats message tonight.
Quick one. Ruby wants the new Zelda for her birthday on July 9. Her boyfriend Colm is already getting her the console stand so don't double up.
Lukas and his wife Eva are celebrating ten years married sometime next month. Big party at her parents' place in Freiburg. They've asked me to say a few words, which, gulp.
Ximena told me Ricardo is going in for knee surgery May 20, after years of football injuries. She's taking time off to look after him. Must call him the day after to see how he's doing.
Gig list for the autumn: Javier wants to see Fontaines DC in Dublin end of October, and I said I'd go. Need to sort flights soon.
Joanna's son has his grade 5 violin exam early next month. She's been driving him to lessons every Thursday for two years. Don't forget to ask her how he got on.
Ahmed is obsessed with Formula 1 at the moment, McLaren especially. Watches every qualifying session at 6am if he has to. Anika thinks he's lost the plot.
Leon mentioned his mum's 70th is June 21st and the family is doing a surprise lunch. He's in charge of the cake and panicking slightly. I'm bringing the dessert wine.
Rebecca's first marathon is Sunday, 4/26. She's really nervous. Text her good luck Saturday night and ask how it went Monday.
Jaya and Hugo have split up. The wedding they'd planned for August is off. She's staying with her sister Deepa for now and seems pretty low. I should check in with her later this week.
Tiago plays bass in a covers band, mostly 90s Britpop. They're doing a pub gig at the Fox sometime in the spring.
Didn't get to talk much, just a quick hello to Colm at the school gate.
Kasia Yilmaz, my old flatmate, is now a sound engineer at the Apollo. She does the monitor mix for touring bands and hates working Sundays.
Rohan's sister is getting married Sept 5 in Goa. Whole family's flying out a week early. He asked if I'd water his plants while he's gone.
Juan says his daughter starts swimming galas in the new year, first one is Jan 18. She trains before school twice a week. He and his partner take it in turns.
Talked to Dr Haddad about the appointment. Follow-up scan sometime in early March, letter to come.
Chiara's mum is in hospital again, chest infection. Chiara's going back and forth from Leeds every weekend and is knackered. Need to ring her Thursday.

Malik plays Warhammer every Friday night at the shop near his work. He's painting a whole Space Wolves army, about sixty models so far. Mentioned a new airbrush would be the dream. Noting for Christmas.

Oisín's play opens March 12 at the Lyric. He's the lead and rehearsals have been brutal, he's barely sleeping. His girlfriend Ruby says he's convinced he'll forget his lines. Remind me to book tickets for the second week and send him a message before opening night.
Jin did the Great North Run last Sunday, finished in 1:52. Way faster than she expected. Should send congrats.
Lola's cat Pickle went missing on Friday. Turned up Monday morning in the neighbour's shed. Lola is mortified about the posters.

Yosef said Ahmed's leaving do is end of the month, drinks after work. Ahmed's moving to Manchester for a new job in early December. He's excited but his wife Anika is less keen, she's only just settled at her school. They're house hunting sometime next week. Yosef is organising a whip-round, so I should chip in a tenner.

Catch-up with Dorota and Nasser at the quiz. Dorota is training for the Bristol 10k on May 31 and runs with a club on Tuesdays. Nasser has taken up pottery, a wheel class on Wednesdays, and keeps showing everyone wonky bowls. Their anniversary is sometime in June, they're thinking about a weekend in Porto. I'm cat-sitting their tabby Moose when they go.
Ask Deepa if she still wants the spare ticket for Hamilton on 6/8.

Kavya's dad retired last week after 35 years on the buses. They had a party at the depot. Now he's talking about walking the Camino over the summer, which her mum thinks is mad. Kavya herself is just back from Lisbon and has her end-of-year review on Nov 3. She wants a promotion this time.
Aaliyah is properly into crochet now. Amigurumi animals, she made a frog for her niece. Wants to sell them at the Christmas market.
Anil's cricket team made the league final, which is August 2. He's opening the batting. His wife Jaya says he's been practising in the garden every evening.
Big week for Eva. Driving test on Tuesday, second attempt, and she is so nervous. Then her sister's baby is due around the 20th. Don't forget to text Eva the morning of the test.
Lukas is a lifelong Dortmund fan, has a season ticket he keeps even though he lives here. Flies over for a home game maybe twice a season.
Picked up the new running shoes. Signing up for the parkrun this Saturday and the 10k sometime in November.
Ximena's daughter is in the school nativity December 10th, she's a sheep. Ximena's working that day and gutted. Her husband is going instead.
Hugo is doing a pottery course on Thursdays until Easter. Hoping to make his own mugs.

Called Ricardo to see how the gig went. He said the Brixton show on Friday was the best they've ever played. They're touring sometime in the spring. Javier, his drummer, broke his wrist the week before though, so they used a stand-in.

Joanna mentioned her husband Tiago got made redundant at the end of September. He's applying everywhere and finding it hard. She's picking up extra shifts. Remind me to check in with Tiago next week, and maybe send him that job link from Rebecca.

Javier's birthday is October 30. He's into vinyl, jazz mostly, Blue Note pressings. Said he's been after an original Coltrane for ages. His partner Ruby says he spends every Saturday morning in the record shop on Hope Street. Also he's got his citizenship interview sometime in November and seems quite stressed about it.
Leon said the pub quiz final got cancelled because the landlord sold up.
Rebecca just found out she's expecting! Due early May. Her partner Kasia is over the moon. Must get a card.

Jaya said her brother Rohan is competing in a powerlifting meet in Birmingham, Nov 14th. He's been cutting weight for weeks and is really stressed about making the class. I'm driving her up there for it.
Hugo loves Wordle and the Guardian cryptic. Does both on the train every morning, gets grumpy if he misses one.
Tiago wants to do a Japan trip sometime next year, maybe in the autumn for the leaves. Saving up already.

Aaliyah Mensah from work, Ally to everyone, has a solo exhibition at the Corn Exchange from May 3 to May 17. Her watercolours. She's terrified nobody will come. I should share the poster on the group chat and go to the opening.
Ricardo and Ximena are hosting a bbq for the Champions League final, June 1. I'm doing the burgers.
Need to renew passport before the summer.
Colm's band is recording an EP over Easter. He plays mandolin and fiddle, trad stuff mostly. His uncle used to play with the Chieftains apparently.
Malik's son starts secondary school in September. Bit worried as he's quite shy. Malik's wife has been doing practice bus journeys with him.
Anika said the Wang twins have their judo grading March 8. Anika's coaching them, and she reckons they'll both pass. Ask her how it went the week after.

Chat with Leon after five-a-side. He's going to Glastonbury for the first time this June, then a stag do in Prague early July for his best mate. He's also teaching himself guitar off YouTube, mostly Oasis. His girlfriend Rebecca thinks he's having a midlife crisis.
Dorota's 40th is sometime in mid-August. She's been dropping hints about a Kindle, the waterproof one.
Lunch with Eva and her mum. Her mum's having a hip replacement on the 3rd, so Eva's moving back home for a few weeks after. Should send flowers once she's out.
